sentences.quote: Florent Menegaux, born in 1962, has been president of the Michelin Group since May 2019, when he succeeded Jean-Dominique Senard after Senard moved to Renault.
sentences.text: Florent Menegaux, born in 1962, has led Michelin as president of the group since May 2019, succeeding Jean-Dominique Senard after Senard's move to Renault.

A graduate in finance and economics from Paris-Dauphine University, he began his career at PricewaterhouseCoopers in 1986 advising banks on interest rate risk management, then worked in logistics at Exel Logistics and Norbert Dentressangle before joining Michelin in 1997 as commercial director for truck tires in the UK and Ireland.

He subsequently held roles across nearly every geography and product line, including North America, South America, Africa/Middle East and Europe, becoming chief operating officer in 2014 and chief executive in 2019.
Investors generally view him favorably as a Michelin lifer and operational executive rather than a financial engineer.
